title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows data: scripts
description: A policy allows data: scripts. Data URLs carry their bytes in the URL, so a script can be assembled from text that never touches an allowed script origin. Browsers execute it in the page context, which defeats the origin restriction the policy intends to enforce.
applicability: HTTPS applications that set Content-Security-Policy with script-src or inherit it from default-src.
risk: Script execution from a scheme with no host origin; MEDIUM severity.
